description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' provides a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to facilitate logging with chaining capabilities. It is part of a logger utility package intended to enhance logging flexibility within Android applications.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's Log functionality and support chaining of log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with the specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable. Forwards the log to the next node if configured.
